d: Former US President Barack Obama couldn't hold back his laughter as he took swipe after swipe at Donald Trump's responses at his rallies, turning his campaign appearance with Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff in Atlanta, Georgia, into a viral sensation. With the US midterm elections approaching, Obama reignited the political battle over Trump's leadership, campaign rhetoric and rally remarks. The high-profile Georgia rally has sparked fresh attention as Democrats ramp up their midterm campaign and challenge Trump ahead of the crucial November elections.
